topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
consensus_response: L-DACS integration impacts spectrum sharing by requiring careful consideration of FDD/TDD modes, power management, Doppler effects, and antenna techniques. Adaptive modulation and cognitive radio technologies enhance spectral efficiency and reduce interference. Machine learning optimizes transmission parameters, predicting channel conditions and minimizing collisions.
reference_context: L-DACS mitigates saturation in A2G communication systems, operating in L-band with FDD/TDD techniques to minimize interference with satellite links.
